about: The spoken script of the film. tools/voice.py turns it into audio/lines/*.wav and audio/narration.json. 'text' is what the caption shows; 'spoken' (optional) is what the voice engine is given when the two differ.

lines.spoken: Two A.M. where he is, and I've got my answer.

lines.speaker: peer

lines.speaker: peer
